Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.filter

Class CombinedFilter

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.filter.CombinedFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogFilter
public final class CombinedFilter extends Object implements LogFilter
The CombinedFilter class represents a composite implementation of the LogFilter interface, allowing multiple filters to be combined into a single filter.

The composed filter only passes log entries if all the constituent filters allow them.

      public CombinedFilter(LogFilter... filters)
      Constructs a CombinedFilter instance by combining multiple LogFilter instances. The resulting filter only passes log entries if all the given filters permit them.
      Parameters:
      filters - the array of LogFilter instances to be combined; each filter is applied sequentially

    • andThen

      public LogFilter andThen(LogFilter other)
      Description copied from interface: LogFilter
      Returns a new LogFilter that represents the composition of this filter and another filter. The resulting filter applies the current filter first, and then applies the specified filter to the result. If the specified filter is LogFilterConstants.ALL_PASS_FILTER, this filter is returned as is. If the specified filter is LogFilterConstants.NONE_PASS_FILTER, the specified filter is returned as is.
      Specified by:
      andThen in interface LogFilter
      Parameters:
      other - the LogFilter to be applied after this filter; must not be null
      Returns:
      a LogFilter representing the composition of this filter and the specified filter
